text: Here's how to play Slana, | step by step.
Slana is an on-chain coin arena game. || You're a coin, | in a live arena on Solana. || Eat smaller players. | Take their tokens. | And be alive at the bell, | to get *paid.*
Start for free. || In the lobby, | pick the Practice ticket | and press Start practice. || No wallet. | No tokens. | Just you, and the bots.
Your coin follows your mouse.
Press Space to split, | and launch half your coin at a runner.
Hold W | to tip out a little mass.
Number keys one to eight send stickers. | Enter opens the chat.
Eat confetti to grow. || To eat another coin, | you need a *quarter* more mass than it has, | and you have to mostly cover it.
So run from bigger coins. || And the bigger you get, | the slower you move.
Rug cacti pop big coins into pieces. | Small coins can hide behind them.
Bots carry no value. || But if a bot eats you, | your tokens spill on the floor as loot. | And only *real* players can grab it.

Ready to play for real? | Connect a wallet, | and buy a ticket. || There are four arenas, | open to everyone, | each with a fixed entry fee. || Penny Pond: | one thousand Slana. | Silver Creek: | ten thousand. | Gold Lake: | fifty thousand. | And Whale Bay: | two hundred fifty thousand.
Your entry fee is your starting value, | and it sits in your till. || Eat a player, | and their tokens move into it.
Arenas play five-minute rounds, | on the clock. || And you can join a round | that's already running.
Joins close in the final minute. || Buy a ticket then, | and it's *held.* | You join the next round by yourself.
Eaten? | Buy back in, | at the same fee, | and jump straight back into the round.
When the bell rings, | everyone still alive | gets paid their till.

The fee only touches *profit.* | It's a flat five percent, | paid to the operator. || Say you enter with one thousand, | and finish on two thousand. | That's one thousand profit. || The fee is fifty, | so you get nineteen fifty.
Lose, or break even? | No fee at all.
And any loot left on the floor at the bell? | It's *burned.*
Quick tips. || Warm up in Practice. | Only split when the catch is sure. || And in the final minute, | play it safe. | You only get paid | if you're alive at the bell.
And the Slana NFT? | A *free* mint. | WL open at slana dot io slash W L.
Slana. | Eat. | Grow. | Last the round. || See you at slana dot io.
